title: Amazon RDS now supports the latest Cumulative Update and GDR updates for Microsoft SQL Server
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with Amazon RDS now supports the latest Cumulative Update and GDR updates for Microsoft SQL Server
body_markdown:
[Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for SQL Server](https://aws.amazon.com/rds/sqlserver/) now supports the latest Cumulative Updates (CU) and General Distribution Release (GDR) updates for Microsoft SQL Server. This release includes support for Microsoft SQL Server 2017 CU31+GDR[KB5122774](https://support.microsoft.com/help/5122774) (RDS version 14.00.3550.4.v1), SQL Server 2019 CU32+GDR[KB5122772](https://support.microsoft.com/help/5122772) (RDS version 15.00.4490.9.v1), SQL Server 2022 CU27[KB5104824](https://support.microsoft.com/help/5104824) (RDS version 16.00.4295.3.v1) and SQL Server 2025 CU9[KB5122048](https://support.microsoft.com/help/5122048) (RDS version 17.00.5005.3.v1).


For additional information on the improvements and fixes included in these updates, see Microsoft documentation for KB5122774, KB5122772, KB5104824 and KB5122048. We recommend that you upgrade your Amazon RDS for SQL Server instances to apply these updates using Amazon RDS Management Console, or by using the AWS SDK or CLI. You can learn more about upgrading your database instance in the[Amazon RDS SQL Server User Guide for upgrading your RDS Microsoft SQL Server DB engine](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_UpgradeDBInstance.SQLServer.html) .
